notes: Tayelet Lev HaIr / Jabotinsky Park municipal pages give no length. OSM 'נחל רבה' ways are tertiary STREETS, so the stream promenade is probably unnamed/unmapped as a path. Forest is KKL — names only. 'שביל גבעת הפרפרים' and 'שביל הדורבנים' (informal, 0.6 km) are OSM-only. OSM park polygons: 'פרק לב העיר' (sic, typo in OSM) and 'פארק נחל רבא' are the closest named areas to the Nahal Raba promenade — used as aliases (park perimeter, low confidence).
